name: Chicago
blurb: A familiar skyline seen the way you see it on an ordinary walk. Lines, light, and the lake.

name: Animals and Birds
blurb: Birds mid turn and animals caught being themselves. Patience, mostly, and a little luck.

name: Landscape
blurb: Wide open places where the light is the subject and the land just holds it.

name: Intentional Camera Movement
blurb: The camera moves on purpose and the world turns soft. Photographs that feel like paintings.

name: Black and White
blurb: Take the color away and what is left is shape, shadow, and feeling.

name: Less Is More
blurb: White frames and soft frames. Very little in the picture, and a great deal to feel.

name: Air and Water Show
blurb: Jets in formation and balloons at first light. Moments that will not hold still.
